proposals.evidence: Turner *dhauvati first branch explicitly includes Nepali dhunu, Maithili dhoeb, Bhojpuri dhowal and Hindi dho-/dhov-. These regional simple wash forms and finite derivatives match that family. The source retroflex and breathy spellings are preserved; compounds and the less clear dhai-/dhe- forms are excluded.
